methodology.comment_scope: Only statements made during the official public-comment or public-hearing block for a specific action are counted toward that action.
methodology.no_comment_meaning: No public comment recorded is not evidence of public support.
methodology.outside_block_rule: Statements made in Citizens Request for Hearing or another non-item-specific segment are not assigned to any vote.
